evidence.claim: Comunello dal 1965 progetta e produce componenti meccanici e sistemi di automazione per cancelli, porte industriali, barriere e serramenti, tutto in Italia.
evidence.quote: Since 1965, Fratelli Comunello has been a benchmark in the design and manufacturing of mechanical components and automation systems for gates, industrial doors, barriers, and window fixtures. || The company is organized into five divisions, with 100% of each division’s products fully designed and manufactured in Italy .
